m2-fix-boundary.title: Fix B2: path-boundary matching instead of bare substring containment
m2-fix-boundary.imperative: Replace 'if path not in prose' with a path-boundary match: a declared path counts as present only when its occurrence in the prose is not immediately preceded by a path character (/, \\, or alphanumeric/./-/_), so a suffix of a longer path does not satisfy it. Add fixtures/tests for: the suffix case (must FAIL, e.g. declared agents/GLOSSARY.md vs prose docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md), a legitimate start-of-string occurrence (must PASS), one preceded by whitespace or a backtick (must PASS), and one preceded by ( or a quote (must PASS). Then run the mandatory regression check: skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json must still lint clean (exit 0) since its prose wraps paths in backticks/parens. Capture a before/after transcript proving the suffix fixture exits 1 after the change where it exited 0 before. Attest c1 before running the GREEN checks.

postconditions.statement: before/after transcript captured showing suffix fixture flips from exit 0 to exit 1 -- manual attest
postconditions.satisfied_by: Before/after transcript captured: suffix fixture (declared agents/GLOSSARY.md, prose docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md) exited 0 pre-fix, exit 1 post-fix, naming the offending path.

postconditions.statement: lint test suite (with new boundary fixtures) passes
